name: Teams Work-Evidence Harvester
sprintRole: Search bounded Microsoft Teams chats and channels for source-grounded work-context evidence and normalize relevant messages without promoting planning, reassignment, or conversation context into paid hours or completed deployment
useWhen: You need to search Teams chats, direct messages, or channels for messages that support, challenge, or refine deployment, configuration, project, or billing-work context for a defined period, person, project, or claim before artifact generation.
inspectFirst: The requested date range, people and aliases, relevant chats/channels, project/workstream, target claims or task categories, current attendance or roster authority for hours/totals, and any existing evidence ledger or artifact-builder handoff destination.
expectedOutput: A compact normalized Teams evidence ledger with one source-grounded record per relevant message or thread, sufficient surrounding context to distinguish requests from completion, explicit direct-versus-inferred status, candidate billing categories only when supported, redistribution/reallocation flags for provisional task context, and a clean handoff to the canonical artifact builder.
nextStep: Run the deliberate second Teams pass across participant aliases, thread replies, and bounded task synonyms, reconcile retained findings against the attendance/roster hour boundary and stronger evidence, then hand normalized findings to P74 Neuron Track Hours Billing Artifact Builder when an updated workbook is requested.
proofGate: The requested Teams scope receives two bounded search passes; every retained claim points to an identifiable chat/channel message or thread; surrounding context is checked where necessary; planning, assignment, reassignment, and completed work remain distinct; attendance/roster evidence remains authoritative for worked dates and paid-hour totals; and candidate categories or redistribution flags are not silently promoted to final allocation.
copyContent:
SEARCH MICROSOFT TEAMS FOR BOUNDED WORK-CONTEXT EVIDENCE. DO NOT TREAT CHAT ACTIVITY AS PAID HOURS OR ASSUME THAT AN ASSIGNMENT MESSAGE PROVES COMPLETED DEPLOYMENT.

SEARCH REQUEST
Period: [month/date range]
People / aliases: [names, spellings, handles]
Chats / channels, if known: [direct chat, group chat, channel]
Project / workstream: [project or `resolve from context`]
Target claim or task family: [deployment, configuration, testing, logistics, support, etc.]
Existing ledger or destination, if supplied: [path/file/record]

MISSION
Search Teams for messages that can support, challenge, or refine the requested work context. Keep this task bounded to evidence discovery and normalization. Do not generate the final billing workbook here.

PASS 1 — DIRECT SEARCH
Search the requested period across the relevant direct chats, group chats, and channels using supplied people, project terms, target task terms, and obvious aliases. For each candidate, inspect enough surrounding replies or nearby messages to determine whether the message records a request, plan, assignment, status update, coordination event, or completed work.

PASS 2 — DELIBERATE RECOVERY PASS
Search again before finishing. Expand only within the selected people/project/time boundary using participant variants, thread replies, project aliases, and task synonyms such as deploy/deployment, configure/configuration, install, test, field work, support, inventory, pickup/drop-off, handoff, or other terms actually suggested by the first pass. Re-open relevant threads where a later reply may confirm, contradict, or reclassify an earlier message. The second pass is required even when the first pass found useful evidence.

EVIDENCE BOUNDARY
- Attendance/roster trackers remain the authority for worked dates, paid-hour totals, and the billed-hour envelope where the current workflow assigns them that role.
- Teams messages are supporting task/work-context evidence. They may confirm work context when the message itself supports the claim, but message volume or presence does not create hours.
- Outlook, Teams, and attached artifacts each have source roles; do not invent a universal ranking where an attachment automatically outweighs communication evidence.
- Requests, plans, assignments, reassignments, staffing moves, and task handoffs are not proof of completed deployment unless later evidence establishes completion.
- Task allocation can be revised over time. If a message suggests that work should be reallocated or redistributed, flag it as a candidate for reconciliation rather than silently rewriting the billing ledger.
- Do not infer hours, quantities, sites, devices, completion, or billing categories absent from the source. Use REVIEW/UNKNOWN where the record is insufficient.

NORMALIZED OUTPUT
Return one concise record per retained message/thread with: source=Teams; timestamp/date; author; chat/channel/thread identity; durable message ID/link when available; relevant participants; supported fact; evidence state DIRECT or INFERRED; candidate billing category or REVIEW/UNKNOWN; redistribution/reallocation candidate YES/NO with reason; and a short note stating what the message does and does not prove. Include only the surrounding context needed to prevent a misleading interpretation.

HANDOFF
Deduplicate repeated chat evidence and preserve contradictions or later corrections. Keep the normalized findings as evidence input. If the operator asks for a new Neuron Track Hours version or billing workbook from these findings, hand the records to the existing P74 `Neuron Track Hours Billing Artifact Builder`; do not create a second artifact-builder workflow or change paid-hour totals inside this harvest step.

DELIVER
Report search scope, pass-1 hits, pass-2 additions/corrections, normalized retained records, unresolved contradictions, redistribution candidates, and the exact evidence set handed to the next stage.
